parole.significato: Abaza, Abazin (member of the Abaza people living in the northwest Caucasus)
parole.testo: 18th century, from абазы (abazy, “Abazins”) + suffix -ин (-in), denoting nationality. From Abaza абаза (abaza, “Abazins, Abkhaz”). Cognate with the Abkhaz endonym аԥсуа (apswa), West Circassian абадзә (“Abazins”), Turkish abaza (“Abkhaz”), also perhaps Ancient Greek Ἀψῑλαι (Apsīlai, “Apsilae”) and O
